title: Which Mountains Carry Each Equipment Rental and Demo Package, and the Cross-Mountain Figure
content:
## Shop network schedule, Equipment Rental and Demo

The collective's shops do not all carry the whole of the Equipment Rental and Demo line. This schedule records, package by package, the mountains whose shops carry it, whether kit from it may be handed in at a mountain other than the one it was collected from, and the fee in USD for handing it in elsewhere.

| Package | Mountains whose shops carry it | Hand-in at another mountain | Cross-mountain figure |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Junior Ski & Board Rental | Granite Ridge, Hollow Creek, Silverpine Basin, Talon Peak, Copper Hollow | allowed | 20.00 USD |
| Basic Ski & Board Rental | Granite Ridge, Hollow Creek, Silverpine Basin, Talon Peak, Copper Hollow | allowed | 20.00 USD |
| Sport Ski & Board Rental | Granite Ridge, Hollow Creek, Silverpine Basin, Talon Peak | allowed | 30.00 USD |
| Performance Ski & Board Rental | Granite Ridge, Silverpine Basin, Talon Peak | not allowed | 45.00 USD |
| Demo Ski & Board Rental | Silverpine Basin, Talon Peak | not allowed | 60.00 USD |
| Season-Long Lease Package | Granite Ridge, Hollow Creek | not allowed | 60.00 USD |

### The columns defined

The first column lists the collective's mountains whose shops carry the package. The second says whether kit from the package may be handed in at a mountain other than the one it was collected from. The third is the fee in USD for handing kit in at a mountain other than the one it was collected from.

### The network read across the line

The two entry packages of the line, the Junior and Basic Ski & Board Rentals, are carried at all five of the collective's mountains. The Sport Ski & Board Rental drops Copper Hollow; the Performance Ski & Board Rental drops Hollow Creek as well and is carried at three; the Demo Ski & Board Rental is carried only in the Wasatch, at Silverpine Basin and Talon Peak. The Season-Long Lease Package is carried on the Front Range only, at Granite Ridge and Hollow Creek.

Flexible hand-in and a low cross-mountain figure travel together. The three packages carried most widely — Junior, Basic and Sport — are the three on which hand-in elsewhere is allowed, at 20.00 USD, 20.00 USD and 30.00 USD. The three narrower packages carry the higher figures, 45.00 USD on the Performance package and 60.00 USD on the Demo and Season-Long Lease packages, and are not written for hand-in elsewhere.

### Points of judgement on this schedule

**A guest asking for Demo kit at Copper Hollow (hypothetical).** Copper Hollow is not among the mountains whose shops carry the Demo Ski & Board Rental; the mountains that carry it are Silverpine Basin and Talon Peak.

**Talon Peak.** Five packages of the line are listed against Talon Peak: the Junior, Basic, Sport, Performance and Demo Ski & Board Rentals. The Season-Long Lease Package is not among them; it is carried at Granite Ridge and Hollow Creek only.
